summary: The main article describes a photoredox nucleophilic (radio)fluorination of TEMPO-derived alkoxyamines, featuring optimization tables, a broad substrate scope scheme, and automated radiosynthesis protocols. The supplementary information provides detailed characterization and synthesis procedures for the precursors and radiolabeled products.

items.heading: Figure 1
items.caption: Prior art and this work.
items.description: Comparison of previous radical-polar crossover and manganese-catalyzed radiofluorination methods with the current TEMPO-derived alkoxyamine photoredox approach.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Reaction Optimization
items.description: Optimization of reaction conditions for the fluorination and radiofluorination of a model benzylic alkoxyamine, screening catalysts, solvents, and additives.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Substrate Scope
items.description: Demonstration of the reaction scope across various secondary, tertiary, and heteroatom-stabilized substrates, including biologically active molecules.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: One-Pot Radiofluorination
items.description: A one-pot procedure for radiofluorination starting directly from alkyl bromide precursors without intermediate purification.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Automated Radiofluorination
items.description: Implementation of the photoredox radiofluorination on a commercial automated radiosynthesis platform using a flow reactor.
